release_notes.description: mp pull integration - Updated connector parameter mode normalization to support string Mode values exported by the Chronicle OnePlatform API while preserving Legacy SOAR integer values.
mp pull playbook - Updated playbook widget metadata parsing to gracefully handle null ConditionsGroup definitions.
mp pull playbook, mp build playbook, mp push playbook - Added support for Case Playbooks execution scope, Case/Alert Reaction Triggers, and reaction condition operators.
mp build - Added manylinux_2_28_x86_64 wheel platform support for dependency packaging.
